text: Before committing each next memory event, an implementation shall detect a conflict with prior completed events by another agent when at least one access is non-atomic and no application happens-before ordering exists. The new access shall then cause `data_race` before exposing a result/effect. Future unexecuted accesses shall not count as violations.
